units.source_text: 今日之会，不用专门诗人，只宣召才能优秀的大学学生十人。

en.t: For today's gathering, no professional poets were used; only ten especially talented university students were summoned.

units.source_text: 仿照式部省文章生考试办法，由皇上敕赐诗题。

en.t: Following the method used for the Ministry of Ceremonial's examination of student writers, the emperor personally bestowed the poetry topic by imperial command.

units.source_text: 这考试想必是为太政大臣家长公子夕雾而设的。

en.t: This examination was surely arranged for Yugiri, the eldest son of the Minister of State's household.

units.source_text: 几个胆怯的学生，每人乘坐一只不系之舟，放在湖里，样子十分周章狼狈。

en.t: Several timid students were each put into an untethered boat and set afloat on the lake, looking utterly flustered and distressed.

units.source_text: 红日渐渐西倾，乐船在池塘中巡回，歌舞大作。

en.t: As the red sun gradually slanted westward, the music boats circled the pond, and songs and dances began in full splendor.

units.source_text: 山风吹送音乐之声，悠扬悦耳。

en.t: The mountain wind carried the sound of the music, long-drawn and pleasing to the ear.

units.source_text: 夕雾独坐舟中作诗，不胜其苦，想道：“我其实不须如此苦学勤修，也可与众人交游取乐。”

en.t: Yugiri sat alone in his boat composing a poem, and finding the ordeal almost unbearable, thought, "In truth, I need not study and discipline myself so painfully; I could still mix with others and enjoy myself."
In his heart he was filled with bitter resentment.
